turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Could you start with telling me what brought you in today?

turns.label: Patient

turns.text: Um, like I've been feeling pretty tired for like a week, but like this bad for like maybe four days.

turns.text: OK, um and so it sounds like you haven't been going to work or like anything like that because you have been so kind of tired and weak.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I mean at first I was already kind of working. I'm I'm a truck driver so you know, once you start the job, you kind of have to finish that. I was supposed to go on another another trip like 4 days ago and I just couldn't. I had to call my boss and say that I can't.

turns.text: OK, um have you had any like specific muscle weakness like in your legs or or in your arms? Or would you say it's overall like a general weakness?
